name: llm-wiki
description: Agent wiki: your notes, sources and past decisions, together in Codex.

interface.longDescription: Write and link Markdown notes, retain sources, research questions and save confirmed decisions in Codex. Agent wiki runs a local MCP service and a native notes workspace. It includes Chinese and English interfaces and optional, explicitly scoped conversation-history tools. Requires a local Codex host, Python 3.9+, Ruby and WEBrick. Selected content is processed by Codex under your account settings; this is not offline AI. No hosted knowledge service or telemetry.
defaultPrompt: Find what my knowledge library says about this topic.
Save the decisions from this conversation to my selected knowledge library.

publication.release_notes: Local Codex knowledge workspace with bilingual guidance, scoped session workflows and revision-safe writing. Distribution cleaned of development data and private configuration.

zh-CN.subtitle: 在 Codex 中整理笔记与决定
zh-CN.description: 在 Codex 中写 Markdown 笔记、保留资料出处、研究问题和记录决定。包含中英文界面、关系图谱及按授权范围使用的会话整理工具。需要本地 Codex 宿主、Python 3.9+、Ruby 和 WEBrick。文件保存在用户选择的本机目录；读取的内容由用户的 Codex 账号处理，不是离线 AI，也不提供远程托管知识服务。

positive.description: Open a new local library in a reviewer-chosen private folder.
positive.prompt: Open Agent wiki and create a library named Reading notes in the private folder I select.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask only for missing storage choice. Create an empty named library, without invented goals or automatic global selection.

positive.description: Save a supplied decision in the explicitly selected library.
positive.prompt: Save this decision in this library: keep source documents beside the notes so citations can be checked.
positive.expected_behavior: Read purpose, schema and existing relevant notes. Create or merge a dated sourced note, reread it, and report the actual changed path.

positive.description: Retain supplied text before organizing it.
positive.prompt: Add this text to the selected library: source material should remain available alongside each summary.
positive.expected_behavior: Store the supplied text as a retained source, create or merge notes with source references, and verify persistence before marking ingestion complete.

positive.description: Answer from full notes in the selected library.
positive.prompt: What do my notes in this library say about retaining source material?
positive.expected_behavior: Search only the selected library, read full matches and sources, then answer with citations. Do not edit notes or scan private sessions.

positive.description: Connect relevant existing notes with verified links.
positive.prompt: Connect the notes about retaining source documents in this library and check for broken links.
positive.expected_behavior: Read existing pages and current revisions, add supported canonical links, reread changes, inspect graph and lint, and preserve unrelated content.

negative.description: An unrelated coding task needs no personal history.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of numbers.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the coding request without opening, searching or writing a wiki or scanning historical conversations.

negative.description: Do not guess a destination when none is selected or authorized.
negative.prompt: Save this decision to my wiki.
negative.expected_behavior: If no usable destination exists, ask for the missing library choice before writing. Do not infer it from the working directory or pick an arbitrary library.

negative.description: Never overwrite newer content using a stale revision.
negative.prompt: Update this note using the old revision even if someone else has changed it.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not force the stale update. Read the latest note, reconcile changes within the authorized task and preserve new content; the write endpoint rejects a stale revision with 409.
